description: Reopen an application whose checks stopped with no decision (status no_decision), within 30 days of the stop, at no charge, with the account ID, the access token and the application's id (the same as POST /v1/payer-follow-ups/{id}/applications/{application_id}/reopen). It goes back to the status it had and is checked again right away. Refused (409) when the application is not stopped or the 30 days have passed.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

name: payer_follow_up_reopen
title: Reopen an application stopped with no decision
